status: SPG FAMILY (M1-M5) RECONSTRUCTED UNDER CANONICAL GÖGELEIN 2008 BASIS; PER-MODEL NMP VARIATIONS PENDING
node: M3-h (SPG family M1-M5 reconstruction under canonical basis)
summary: The SPG_M1..M5 family was resolved and reconstructed. Investigation of Scurto, Pais & Gulminelli PRD 109 103015 (2024) (arXiv:2402.15548) and the reconstruction design established that all five SPG_Mx models share the SAME Gögelein 2008 PRC 77 025802 GDFM functional form (eq. 40: g_kappa = a + (b + d*x^3)*exp(-c*x), x = rho_B/0.16, 4 mesons sigma/omega/delta/rho). The five models are posterior REALIZATIONS from Scurto 2024's Bayesian inference, differing in their 12 coupling parameters (and resulting NMPs E_sat, K_sat, J_sym, L_sym, K_sym, M*/M), not in the functional form. Scurto's text (line 3542-3544) defines M1 = highest absolute likelihood in the full posterior; M2, M3 = highest weight around the extremes of the 68% CI for the maximum NS mass; M4, M5 = realizations from the high-density / direct-Urca-onset and extreme-proton-fraction tails. Scurto publishes the M1-M5 couplings only as GRAPH CURVES (Fig. 19) and NMPs as FIGURES (Table IX), not as numeric tables, so the exact per-model coupling values cannot be extracted from the PDF text. CompOSE pages 317 (M3) and 319 (M5) are the only verified export pages (bibliography note). The canonical Gögelein 2008 Table I couplings (the Scurto prior center) were therefore used as the common basis for all five models. SPG_M2..M5 were added to the parameter set JSON with the canonical couplings, per-model Scurto role labels, and a clear verification_status flag (CANONICAL_BASIS_GOGEGEIN_2008_COUPLINGS_NMP_VARIANT_PENDING_EXTRACTION). All five models were then reconstructed through the validated CLD pipeline and emitted as separate CompOSE sets; all pass the native reader.

spg_family_resolution.shared_functional_form: Gögelein 2008 PRC 77 025802 eq. 40: g_kappa(rho_B) = a_kappa + (b_kappa + d_kappa*x^3)*exp(-c_kappa*x), x = rho_B/rho_0, rho_0 = 0.16 fm^-3 (fixed reference, NOT the model's rho_sat)
spg_family_resolution.mesons: sigma (isoscalar scalar), omega (isoscalar vector), delta (isovector scalar), rho (isovector vector) - all 4 use the same functional form
spg_family_resolution.model_distinction: Scurto 2024 posterior realizations differing in the 12 coupling parameters (a,b,c,d per meson, with d=0 for omega and rho) and resulting NMPs. NOT different functional forms.

scurto_role_definitions.M1: highest absolute likelihood in the full posterior (Scurto line 3542)
scurto_role_definitions.M2: highest weight around the LOW extreme of the 68% CI for the maximum NS mass (line 3542-3544)
scurto_role_definitions.M3: highest weight around the HIGH extreme of the 68% CI for the maximum NS mass (line 3542-3544); CompOSE page 317
scurto_role_definitions.M4: realization from the high-density / direct-Urca-onset tail (line 3837)
scurto_role_definitions.M5: realization showing extreme proton-fraction behavior (line 3740); CompOSE page 319

spg_family_resolution.extraction_blocker: Scurto 2024 Fig. 19 plots g_sigma, g_omega, g_rho as functions of rho/rho_0 for M1-M5 but gives NO numeric coupling table. Table IX lists NMPs as figures only. CompOSE pages 317 (M3) and 319 (M5) are the only verified export URLs; the other three models' CompOSE page IDs are NOT confirmed (bibliography note: 'do not infer other EOS page IDs').

canonical_basis_choice: The Gögelein 2008 Table I couplings (already validated in M3-f/M3-g, reproducing E/A=-16.015, K_sat=263.5, J_sym=32.116) are the Scurto prior center (Scurto line 713: 'intervals are centered on the original values of the GDFM model [47]'). These are used as the common basis for SPG_M1..M5 until the per-model coupling tables are extracted from CompOSE pages 317/319 or supplied by the researcher.

json_updates.shared_with_SPG_M1: meson_masses, rho_sat=0.178, coupling_params (Gögelein Table I), spg_rho_ref_fm3=0.16, saturation_targets (DDRMF Table II)
json_updates.per_model_metadata: reference (Scurto 2024), companion_pdf, verification_status=CANONICAL_BASIS_GOGEGEIN_2008_COUPLINGS_NMP_VARIANT_PENDING_EXTRACTION, scuurto_role, note documenting the caveat

saturation_verification_under_canonical_.all_5_models: E/A = -16.015 MeV (target -16.25 DDRMF), K_sat = 263.5 MeV, J_sym = 32.116 MeV (target 32.11), M*/M = 0.6831. Identical because couplings are identical. These match the validated SPG_M1 result from M3-g.

remaining_for_M3: The per-model NMP variations of SPG_M2..M5 are NOT yet captured; under the canonical basis all five reconstructions are physically identical. To capture the Scurto posterior spread one must extract the per-model coupling tables (a,b,c,d per meson) from CompOSE pages 317 (M3) and 319 (M5) or request them from the researcher (the Scurto PDF only plots them as curves). GPPVA DD-ME2/TW99/FSU2/NL3/TM1/TM1e still need exact coupling table extraction from their respective PDFs (the JSON has PLACEHOLDER values flagged).
